feminine_die_red.visual_anchor: Red / Wonder Woman / Dynamic female superhero
feminine_die_red.heuristic_rule: Nouns ending in -e (two-syllables) are ~80% feminine (die Lampe, die Tasche, die Tasse, die Straße, die Flasche).

neuter_das_green.visual_anchor: Green / Hulk / Solid inert material or diminutive
neuter_das_green.heuristic_rule: All nominalized infinitives (das Essen, das Trinken, das Leben) and open-vowel loanwords (das Sofa, das Auto, das Foto) take DAS.

masculine_der_blue.visual_anchor: Blue / Superman / Male agent or concrete tool
masculine_der_blue.heuristic_rule: Days of the week (der Montag), months (der Januar), seasons (der Sommer), compass directions (der Norden), and weather phenomena (der Regen, der Wind) are 100% DER.

dative_cadence.cadence_hack: Chanted to the melody of 'The Blue Danube' or rhythmic cadence: 'aus-bei-mit-nach-seit-von-zu'

accusative_rhyme.mnemonic: D-O-G-F-U-B (Durch, Ohne, Gegen, Für, Um, Bis)

two_way_prepositions_triad.wo_trigger: Static Location / Rest / State ➔ DATIV (Dativ = Dot / Der Ort / Rest)

temporal_triad.AM: Days (am Montag), Dates (am 1. Mai), Day-parts (am Morgen, am Abend) [Exception: in der Nacht]
temporal_triad.IM: Months (im Juli), Seasons (im Sommer), Years (im Jahr 2026)
temporal_triad.UM: Precise clock times (um 14:00 Uhr, um Viertel vor acht)

v2_and_inversion_trick.rule: The finite conjugated verb is glued to POSITION 2 in main clauses.
v2_and_inversion_trick.inversion: If you start with Time, Place, or Object in Position 1 ➔ Subject flips to Position 3!

tekamolo_rule.example: Ich fahre heute (TE) wegen des Regens (KA) mit dem Bus (MO) zur Arbeit (LO).

am_progressive_hack.hack: Expresses ongoing '-ing' actions without complex tenses (vernacular German continuous).
examples: Ich bin am Arbeiten. (I am working right now)
Er ist am Kochen. (He is cooking right now)
Wir sind am Lernen. (We are learning right now)

phonetic_keys.ich_laut: Soft /ç/ after e, i, ä, ö, ü, ei, eu (tongue touches molars, soft hissing cat sound: 'ich', 'nicht', 'Bücher').
phonetic_keys.ach_laut: Hard /x/ after a, o, u, au (throat scraping: 'Buch', 'machen', 'doch').
phonetic_keys.uvular_r: Produced in back of throat like gentle gargling with water, or vocalized /ɐ/ at end of syllables ('Wasser' -> 'Wassa').
phonetic_keys.glottal_stop: Knacklaut — tiny micro-pause before vowels starting a root word (e.g. 'be-achten', 'Spiegel-ei').

modal_particles_fillers.function: Soft hedge / hesitation bridge ('well... / kind of')
Accepting reality / 'that's just how it is'
Actually / By the way / In reality
Contradicting a negative ('Doch, das stimmt!') or emphasis

pedagogical_algorithms.micro_srs_2_7_15: Failed items are dynamically re-prompted within the session at: 2 minutes (immediate cloze), 7 minutes (embedded in sentence frame), and 15 minutes (session close rapid-fire quiz).
pedagogical_algorithms.active_ratio_60_40: The learner must produce at least 60% of spoken words. AI responses are strictly limited to prompts under 15 words.
pedagogical_algorithms.dual_memory_loop: Every session concludes with the Physical Notebook Protocol (Human Handwriting + Read Aloud + Post-Writing Retrieval).
